jobs.title: Equity Analyst
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Research team. You will conduct in-depth fundamental research on companies across developed markets, with a specific focus on Technology, develop comprehensive financial models, and deliver high-conviction investment recommendations to internal stakeholders, especially portfolio managers and advisors. You will report to a senior analyst responsible for Technology research and investments.

Your role

• Assisting the senior Technology equity research analyst covering the Technology sector.
• Taking over some of the existing coverage of the Technology sector.
• Expanding existing coverage of the Technology sector.

• Building and maintaining complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Conducting management interviews, attending conferences, and interacting with sell side analysts.
• Designing and deploying AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate and improve idea generation and fundamental research.

• Sourcing and researching investment ideas to be invested in the Technology portfolio.
• Publishing investment content on internal and external platforms.
• Making stock recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
• Participating in marketing and servicing activities for internal and external stakeholders.

.

Your profile

• University degree: ideally Master’s degree or a postgraduate qualification such as a CFA.
• A minimum of 5 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, in the Technology sector. Prior exposure to an Anglo-Saxon firm is a strong plus.
• Native or equivalent written and spoken English, fluent or better written and spoken French.

• Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative (but not quant) skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.
• Outstanding written communication skills (investment memos, research notes) and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly.

• Complete proficiency in Bloomberg (terminal and Excel API), Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid working knowledge of VBA.
• Confident and effective user of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications) to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency.

• Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Ability to work under pressure and to meet demanding deadlines.
• Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.

Applications for candidates without the minimum required experience in the Technology will not be considered and will be rejected automatically. Bloomberg, Excel, VBA, and other specific skills will be tested and evaluated specifically, in writing.

We do not speculate, we invest, if you are unsure about the difference, please don’t apply.

La tua squadra

Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un'offerta completa per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

Stiamo cercando un diligente e intuitivo Buy-Side Analyst per aderire al nostro team di ricerca. Condurrai ricerche fondamentali approfondite sulle aziende di tutti i mercati sviluppati, con un focus specifico sulla tecnologia, svilupperai modelli finanziari completi e fornirai raccomandazioni di investimento ad alta concorrenza agli stakeholder interni, in particolare ai responsabili del portafoglio e ai consulenti. Ti riferirai a un analista senior responsabile della ricerca e degli investimenti in tecnologia.

Il tuo ruolo

• Assistere l'analista di ricerca dell'equità tecnologica senior che copre il settore tecnologico.
• Prendendo in esame una parte della copertura esistente del settore tecnologico.
• Ampliamento della copertura esistente del settore tecnologico.

• Costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari complessi e dinamici per prevedere guadagni e rendimenti futuri.
• Condurre colloqui di gestione, partecipare a conferenze, e interagire con gli analisti laterali di vendita.
• Progettazione e distribuzione di strumenti e flussi di lavoro basati su AI per accelerare e migliorare la generazione di idee e la ricerca fondamentale.

• Sourcing e ricerca di idee di investimento da investire nel portafoglio tecnologico.
• Pubblicazione di contenuti di investimento su piattaforme interne ed esterne.
• Promuovere raccomandazioni stock a stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Partecipazione alle attività di marketing e assistenza per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea universitaria: idealmente laurea o una qualifica post-laurea come un CFA.
• Un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza di ricerca azionaria sul lato di acquisto o di vendita, nel settore tecnologico. L'esposizione precedente a una ditta anglosassone è un vantaggio forte.
• Originaria o equivalente scritto e parlato inglese, fluente o meglio scritto e parlato francese.

• Forte capacità fondamentali di ricerca azionaria con eccellenti capacità quantitative (ma non quanti) e un approccio basato su principi all'analisi e alla comunicazione.
• Competenze di comunicazione scritta (memoria di investimento, note di ricerca) e eccellenti capacità di presentazione per trasmettere idee complesse in modo chiaro e convincente.

• Completa competenza in Bloomberg (terminal e Excel API), Microsoft Excel e PowerPoint; solida conoscenza di lavoro di VBA.
• Confidente ed efficace utente di strumenti AI (ad esempio ChatGPT, Claude e applicazioni simili) per migliorare la produttività della ricerca, la generazione di informazioni e l'efficienza del flusso di lavoro.

• Personalità indipendente, intuitiva, auto-starter con un forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità.
• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e di rispettare scadenze impegnative.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera, o disposto a trasferirsi.

Le domande di candidati senza l'esperienza minima richiesta nella tecnologia non saranno considerate e saranno respinte automaticamente. Bloomberg, Excel, VBA e altre abilità specifiche saranno testate e valutate specificamente, per iscritto.

Non speculare, investiamo, se non sei sicuro della differenza, non applicare.

• Unterstützung des Senior Technology Equity Research Analysten für den Technologiesektor.

• Erweiterung der bestehenden Abdeckung des Technologiesektors.

• Aufbau und Pflege komplexer, dynamischer Finanzmodelle zur Vorhersage zukünftiger Erträge und Renditen.
• Durchführung von Management-Interviews, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Interaktion mit Sell Side Analysten.
• Entwicklung und Einsatz von KI-gestützten Tools und Workflows zur Beschleunigung und Verbesserung der Ideengenerierung und Grundlagenforschung.

• Beschaffung und Erforschung von Anlageideen, die in das Technologieportfolio investiert werden sollen.
• Veröffentlichung von Anlageinhalten auf internen und externen Plattformen.
• Erstellung von Bestandsempfehlungen für interne und externe Stakeholder.
• Teilnahme an Marketing- und Serviceaktivitäten für interne und externe Stakeholder.

• Universitätsabschluss: Idealerweise Master-Abschluss oder eine postgraduale Qualifikation wie ein CFA.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Aktienresearch auf der Kauf- oder Verkaufsseite im Technologiesektor. Eine vorherige Exposition gegenüber einem angelsächsischen Unternehmen ist ein starkes Plus.

• Starke grundlegende Equity-Research-Fähigkeiten mit hervorragenden quantitativen (aber nicht quantitativen) Fähigkeiten und einem auf ersten Prinzipien basierenden Ansatz für Analyse und Kommunikation.
• Hervorragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Investmentmemos, Research Notes) und hervorragende Präsentationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Ideen klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln.

Votre équipe

Pictet Wealth Management combine plus de 200 ans d'héritage bancaire suisse avec une expertise en investissement mondial. Le groupe de services financiers appartenant à des partenaires offre une offre complète aux personnes et aux familles riches, y compris des solutions d'investissement discrétionnaires et consultatives et des services de bureau familial.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste des achats diligent et perspicace pour rejoindre notre équipe de recherche. Vous effectuerez des recherches fondamentales approfondies sur les entreprises dans les marchés développés, en mettant l'accent sur la technologie, développerez des modèles financiers complets et fournirez des recommandations d'investissement à haute conviction aux intervenants internes, en particulier aux gestionnaires de portefeuille et aux conseillers. Vous relèverez d'un analyste principal responsable de la recherche et des investissements technologiques.

Votre rôle

• Aider l'analyste principal de la recherche sur l'équité technologique dans le secteur de la technologie.
• Prise en charge d'une partie de la couverture existante du secteur de la technologie.
• Élargir la couverture actuelle du secteur de la technologie.

• Construire et maintenir des modèles financiers complexes et dynamiques pour prévoir les gains et les rendements futurs.
• Mener des entrevues de gestion, assister à des conférences et interagir avec des analystes commerciaux.
• Concevoir et déployer des outils et des flux de travail axés sur l'IA pour accélérer et améliorer la production d'idées et la recherche fondamentale.

• Sourcing et recherche d'idées d'investissement à investir dans le portefeuille Technologie.
• Publication de contenus d'investissement sur des plateformes internes et externes.
• Faire des recommandations aux intervenants internes et externes.
• Participation aux activités de marketing et de service pour les intervenants internes et externes.

.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire: idéalement Master ou diplôme de troisième cycle comme une CFA.
• Un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience de recherche en actions du côté des achats ou de la vente, dans le secteur de la technologie. Une exposition antérieure à une entreprise anglo-saxonne est un plus fort.
• Natif ou équivalent écrit et parlé anglais, couramment ou mieux écrit et parlé français.

• Fortes capacités de recherche sur l'équité fondamentale avec d'excellentes compétences quantitatives (mais pas quantiques) et une approche fondée sur les premiers principes en matière d'analyse et de communication.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite (mémorandums d'investissement, notes de recherche) et excellentes compétences en présentation pour transmettre des idées complexes clairement et de manière convaincante.

• Compétence complète en Bloomberg (API terminal et Excel), Microsoft Excel et PowerPoint; solide connaissance de travail de VBA.
• Utilisation fiable et efficace d'outils d'IA (p. ex. ChatGPT, Claude et applications similaires) pour améliorer la productivité de la recherche, la production d'information et l'efficacité du workflow.

• Personnalité indépendante, intuitive et autodidacte, avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation et de responsabilité.
• Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais exigeants.
• Il doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager.

Les candidatures pour les candidats sans l'expérience minimale requise dans la technologie ne seront pas prises en considération et seront rejetées automatiquement. Bloomberg, Excel, VBA, et d'autres compétences spécifiques seront testés et évalués spécifiquement, par écrit.

Nous ne spéculons pas, nous investissons, si vous n'êtes pas sûr de la différence, s'il vous plaît ne postulez pas.

Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’500 people. The group is owned and managed by seven partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people.

The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse. We are looking for an experienced Safekeeping & Cash Desk Specialist to join our team in Zurich. As a key member of our motivated team, you will be working within the bank’s Custody, Reporting & Regulatory Services division.

Your role

Your responsibilities include the following:

• Manage cash operations, including withdrawals, deposits and currency exchange for the Zurich and Basel branches

• Oversee the central fund and maintain currency stock levels as well as ensure smooth operation and refilling of ATM terminals

• Handle the physical securities, precious metals, coins, cheques and coordinate money transport

• Manage safe deposit boxes for clients and employees, including opening, closing and maintenance

• Provide administrative and secretarial support, including mail handling, manage office supplies and coordinating gifts

• Proactively organize and coordinate a variety of engaging internal and external events

Your profile

• Completed commercial apprenticeship or equivalent further education

• Two to three years’ experience in banking, ideally with cash operations, managing central funds as well as handling physical securities

• Experience and genuine enthusiasm for working with high-end clientele

• Strong IT skills and proficiency in common applications

• Strong team player, with the ability to work independently

• Flexible, with excellent interpersonal skills and professional manners

• Fluent in German and English, French is a plus

Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 700 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Tax departments.

You will be part of the Finance – Group Corporate Services team within the Finance department.

Your role

As a member of the Finance team, you will be responsible for financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting, and for providing insightful advice to senior management. This position requires strong analytical skills and close collaboration across departments to ensure financial and analytical processes are robust and relevant, supporting strategic decision-making and the Group’s financial initiatives.

You will be in charge of:

• Delivering monthly financial results to senior management on time, together with business metrics and supporting in-depth analyses of the GCS division’s cost drivers.

• Contributing meaningfully to the Group’s budgeting and forecasting processes, including business and financial modelling, the multi-year plan, variance analysis and performance reviews.

• Developing reports and data visualisation tools that highlight key elements and drivers of financial performance and make complex data accessible and actionable.

• Developing a deep understanding of Pictet GCS’s costs allocation mechanisms to business lines.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather financial data, develop analyses and support decision-making.

• Conducting targeted financial and strategic analysis to identify trends, business and cost drivers as well as opportunities for improvement.

Your profile

• Master’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

• At least 2–5 years’ experience in financial analysis, controlling or a related role.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle complex financial issues.

• A sense of urgency, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Proficiency in data management and visualisation tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau and Snowflake.

• Proficiency in using advanced digital and AI-powered tools (including generative AI) to enhance financial analysis, automate recurring tasks and improve the quality and efficiency of reporting.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.

• Fluency in French and English is essential.

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

As the successful candidate, you will be expected to apply strong analytical skills, demonstrate initiative and collaborate effectively within a dynamic team. You will also be keen to embrace the Group’s values and consistently put them into practice in your daily activities.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

PWM is seeking to recruit a Senior Wealth Planner for its Wealth Solutions unit in Geneva or Zurich.

As a member of our Geneva or Zurich-based Wealth Planning team, you will cover Eastern European, CIS and Baltic countries. You will help bankers and their clients/prospects manage tax and legal issues concerning their private wealth and ensure client satisfaction with tailor-made solutions. This role requires you to draw on your own expertise as well as on that of external specialists. You will also follow a strategic business development approach.

Your role

• Guide bankers and clients on personal taxation, relocation, residential real estate investment, succession planning and wealth structuring (private investment companies, trusts, foundations, private funds, life insurance contracts,) and other legal matters.

• Draw on internal wealth planning expertise (for questions pertaining to other markets) and your external network and co-ordinate legal and tax issues.

• Perform the job in a complex environment where you will be required to analyse, summarise and interpret several options to enable you to propose pragmatic solutions.

• Monitor the main tax/wealth structuring/legal developments for the jurisdictions covered (e.g. tax & legal watch, cross-border rules, etc.), and keep both clients and bankers informed of opportunities and risks in these domains (through internal communications, client publications, presentations, workshops, etc.).

• Share knowledge and experience with the other wealth planners by playing an active role at team meetings and actively contribute to overall team projects.

• Develop and maintain a network of trusted third-party advisors, notaries, fiduciaries and trust companies and co-ordinate the use of advisors where required.

• Keep abreast of any developments with tax, legal or regulatory rules that have an impact on WP team activities as well as with internal directives, attending mandatory training sessions and complying with such rules.

• Ensure cooperation and alignment with the activities of Wealth Solutions and act as an ambassador for the unit.

Your profile

• University degree in Law or Economics, or a qualification deemed equivalent.

• At least 10 years’ prior experience in private client work/wealth planning, e.g. in a law firm, big four firm or bank.

• A fiscal qualification in the covered jurisdictions of the zones listed above would be a plus.

• Fluency in English and Russian (written and spoken) is required. A very good command of French or German is strongly preferred. Knowledge of at least one additional Eastern European language is an asset.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

As a Client Relationship Officer in our Zurich office you will be working in the German Speaking Switzerland Team and you will be the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients.

Your role

Your responsibilities include the following:

• Administer the end-to-end account-opening process, taking into consideration local regulatory specificities

• Secure strict follow-up of documentation (e.g. pending items, middle office and R&C lists)

• Procure KYC information and update complementary documents in the systems

• Close coordination with the zone’s Business Risk Manager to resolve risk and compliance matters

• Adjust to all existing policies and directives and support the implementation of new ones, where needed

• Edit payments and stock exchange orders while ensuring call backs are systematically performed

• Build close relationships with relevant internal stakeholders

• Support assistance with administrative tasks when required

• Bachelor's degree or similar relevant qualification

• Minimum of 10 years experience in a similar function

• Fluent in English; German and French are a plus

• Understand client documentation and internal processes of a wealth manager

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Tech division specialises in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

As part of the Software Engineering team, whose mission is to provide the Group’s banking business lines with tools dedicated to transaction management, you will help design innovative new features and enhance existing applications in an Agile environment. You will work closely with engineers and business stakeholders to build cloud-ready, data-driven solutions, leveraging AI to boost productivity.

Your role

• Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders and IT teams, gathering, challenging and translating requirements into clear functional and technical specifications, particularly in ETD trading, OTC trading, settlement and reconciliation, and interbank messaging.

• Work closely with the product manager to support product discovery and product strategy through the analysis of business challenges, operational constraints and business opportunities.

• Translate business needs into functional and non-functional requirements (epics, user stories, acceptance criteria), ensuring traceability to business objectives and contributing to solution feasibility assessments with architects and the development team.

• Collaborate closely with developers and architects to design solutions leveraging modern architectures, including APIs, event-driven patterns, cloud technologies, AI and advanced analytics capabilities.

• Configure and implement business requirements, perform and/or coordinate testing activities (functional, regression and user acceptance testing), and maintain up-to-date documentation and release notes.

• Support backlog refinement and sprint planning, clarify requirements with developers, QA engineers and DevOps teams, and contribute to the timely and high-quality delivery of product increments.

• Ensure the reliability and availability of solutions in production, monitor application performance and system behaviour, and coordinate deployment activities.

• Analyse and resolve production incidents (L2/L3 support), perform root cause analysis and collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to implement sustainable fixes and continuous improvements.

• Provide support to business stakeholders in Switzerland and abroad, gather feedback and translate it into continuous product improvements.

• Collaborate closely with Pictet Technologies Portugal and other internal partners to ensure end-to-end alignment across teams and platforms.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

• Strong technical understanding of software development, ideally including PL/SQL, combined with the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Hands-on experience with Avaloq customisation would be a strong advantage.

• Experience with Java or another object-oriented programming language is highly desirable.

• Practical exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and a strong interest in AI-enabled solutions, automation and data-driven decision-making.

• Strong business acumen and a solid understanding of banking products, processes and transaction lifecycles.
